report_name: Law Firm Investigates AECOM Data Breach After Hacker Groups Claim Theft

threat_actors.name: Metaencryptor
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group that publicly claimed responsibility for breaching the infrastructure firm AECOM and exfiltrating approximately 1.22 TB of corporate data around September 17, 2026. The group is engaged in a double-extortion scheme.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft and extortion for financial gain.

threat_actors.name: BrainCipher
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group attributed with a data leak of around 670 GB from the infrastructure firm AECOM. The activity is related to the breach claimed by Metaencryptor, suggesting a possible collaboration or affiliate relationship.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft and extortion for financial gain.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Exfiltration
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor groups Metaencryptor and BrainCipher claimed to have stolen over 1.2 terabytes of corporate data from AECOM in a large-scale data theft operation.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: The attack on AECOM is a double-extortion scheme where the threat actors use the stolen data as leverage to demand a ransom payment.

identities.name: AECOM
identities.description: A multinational infrastructure firm targeted by the Metaencryptor and BrainCipher hacker groups, who claimed to have stolen over a terabyte of corporate data, prompting a class-action investigation.

indicators.name: Suspicious Archiving with Command-Line Tool
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Archiving with 7-Zip
id: 2b1a9c8d-e3f4-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 7-Zip from the command line to create a password-protected archive, a common tactic for data staging before exfiltration.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aecom-data-breach-investigation-edelson-lechtzin-llp-probes-class-action-claims-after-hackers-allege-theft-of-more-than-1-tb-of-data-302884076.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-21
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\7z.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' a '
      - ' -p'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of archiving tools like 7-Zip to compress data with a password before exfiltration, as suggested in the article's hunting hints.

indicators.name: Data Exfiltration with Rclone
indicators.pattern:
title: Data Exfiltration Tool Rclone Execution
id: 9f8e7d6c-5b4a-4c3d-8b2a-1c0d9e8f7a6b
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a data synchronization tool often abused by threat actors for data exfiltration to cloud services.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aecom-data-breach-investigation-edelson-lechtzin-llp-probes-class-action-claims-after-hackers-allege-theft-of-more-than-1-tb-of-data-302884076.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-21
tags:
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.t1105
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a tool that can be used for large-scale data exfiltration, as suggested in the article's hunting hints.
